title: Domestic and International Wire Transfer Guidelines
content: Domestic wire requests submitted before 4:00 PM EST on business days are processed same-day with a fixed fee of $25. Incoming domestic wires are free of charge. International wire transfers require 1 to 3 business days for completion, incur a $45 outgoing transfer fee, and require full recipient SWIFT/BIC and IBAN details. Wire cancellation is only possible before release to the network.
